provenance.supersedes: the +875.5% / Sharpe 2.70 record, which was leaked - see note
provenance.note: The previous record was produced by docs/research/harness/ml_record.py, whose dataset builder summed the funding features FORWARD from each decision date over realised rates. funding_7d/30d/chg/z therefore carried days that had not happened yet, and funding tracks contemporaneous price pressure closely enough that this is nearly a copy of the target. The walk-forward itself was sound; the features were not. Flipping the window to trailing and changing nothing else took that same harness from +760.7%/Sharpe 2.54 to +134.9%/1.05. This record uses trailing windows throughout and retrains per fold, so no date is scored by a model that saw it.
